subject: bio
title: Cell Structure
subtitle: Cell Structure with mechanism-focused explanation and exam-linked examples.
concept: Cell structure links biological function to physical organization. Compartmentalization in eukaryotes allows specialized reactions to occur efficiently at the same time.
Prokaryotic cells are smaller and simpler, with no membrane-bound nucleus. Their structure suits rapid replication and metabolic flexibility.
Exam questions often combine structural comparison, organelle function, and microscope interpretation. Clear terminology is essential for full marks.
